category.categoryNote:
Waxing is a method of semi-permanent hair removal which removes the hair from the root. The effects last for between 2-6 weeks – depending on the individuals rate of hair growth, the time of year and how long you have been having the area waxed.

Warm wax is applied to the skin in a thin layer. The hair becomes embedded in the wax and a strip is applied and then pulled off quickly, in the opposite direction of the hair growth, taking the hair with it.

items.subCategoryHeader: Professional Waxing & Hair Removal Services for Women

category.categoryNote: Sugaring hair removal is an ancient Middle Eastern practice that uses an all-natural paste or gel made from sugar, water, and lemon juice, and sometimes honey, salt, and essentials oils. It removes the hair follicle from the root with results that can last up to six weeks. Sugaring hair removal (sugar waxing) is 100% natural and offers lots of benefits making hair removal gentle, skin friendly and very effective. Less pain and a minimized risk of ingrown hair are just some of the huge advantages you will fall in love with. Sugaring paste is applied at body temperature & will not burn your skin. Hot wax must be heated to a high degree in order to become liquefied which can cause burning & scarring.

items.subCategoryHeader: Expert Sugaring for Facial Hair Removal

category.categoryNote:
Threading is an ancient hair removal technique, cherished for centuries by the women of Asia and the Middle East for its precision and effectiveness. It offers a gentle alternative to waxing and tweezing, especially for sensitive skin. At Merinaz, our threading expert uses a thin cotton thread, twisting it into a double strand, which is then expertly swept along the skin. With rhythmic, almost hypnotic movements, the unwanted hairs are trapped in the thread and lifted from the follicle with incredible precision.

A simple eyebrow threading takes just 5-7 minutes, while the upper lip requires about 3 minutes, and a full face threading typically takes 15-20 minutes.

Hard wax is a premium hair removal method that adheres to the hair rather than the skin, making it a gentler and less painful option, especially for sensitive areas like the face, underarms, and bikini line. Unlike soft wax, it hardens on its own and is removed directly without the need for strips, ensuring a cleaner and more efficient process. Hard wax effectively removes even the shortest and finest hairs while minimizing redness and irritation, making it ideal for facial waxing, underarms, arms, legs, and Brazilian waxing. Experience smooth, flawless skin with our high-quality hard wax—book your appointment today!

category.categoryNote: Eyebrow tint is a form of semi-permanent hair-dye formulated specifically for use on the eyebrows. Eyebrow tinting is a lot safer than attempting to dye your eyebrows at home with hair-dye, which is something many women do. Putting any sort of chemical near the eyes is extremely hazardous and inadvisable. An eyebrow tint should take no longer than 20-25 minutes.

Hair Trimming is the process of maintaining the body hair without shaving it from the root. Here at Merinaz, we use different devices and techniques to reduce or maintain body hair. Trimming is usually done for neat and tidy looks without a clean shave. The process of hair trimming can take up to 30 minutes, depending on the client's hair condition.

category.categoryNote: A facial is a professional cleansing, purifying, and beautifying treatment of the skin on the face and neck. Facials are the number one treatment performed by aesthetician, and a good way for your therapist to get a good understanding of your skin prior to suggesting more aggressive treatments. A basic facial cleanses pores, exfoliates away dead skin cells, and treats common skin concerns with a custom mask. It is meant to rejuvenate faces and pamper clients. A mini facial may be only 20–30 minutes in length, while a more luxurious version may be 75–90 minutes in length.

items.itemDescription: A HydraFacial is a facial treatment using a patented device to deliver exfoliation, cleansing, extraction, and hydration to the face. This system uses a vortex swirling action to deliver hydration and to remove dead skin, dirt, debris, and impurities while cleaning and soothing your skin.

category.categoryNote: Eyelash Extensions is a popular new service that lengthens and thickens your natural eyelashes. Lash Extensions are single strands of synthetic eyelashes that are curved to replicate a natural eyelash. They are applied to each individual natural eyelash one by one for a natural, beautiful and luscious look. Eyelash Extensions are perfect for special occasions or for everyday wear. With proper application, meaning one synthetic eyelash applied to one natural lash the look and feel is completely natural looking and real. No one will know you have extensions. They will just think you were born with beautiful, long lashes! The application process for lash extensions normally takes anywhere from 1.5 hours to 2.5 hours. You will lay comfortably on a massage or facial table with your eyes closed. The Eyelash professional will then apply an under eye gel pad to cover your lower lashes and upper lids. Then the extensions will be applied to each individual eyelash on a lash by lash basis.
